theme_strategy: Light Theme Default (To ensure maximum readability for all age groups and rural demographics, especially when reading long eligibility criteria or localized text).

rules: No generic sans-serif like Inter for headings.
Variable weights: Use font-light or font-black for tension and contrast.
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.
Ensure IBM Plex Sans is loaded properly as it offers excellent support for Devnagari and other Indian scripts.

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Calm) blended with approachable high-contrast utility.
rules: Never use pure black or gray; always tint grays with a hint of warm stone or cool blue.
Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for text. APCA standard applies.
Hover states must be explicitly defined for text and background.
Use Saffron Orange (#EA580C) strictly for active states, 'Apply Now' CTAs, and progress markers to drive attention.
Use Emerald Green (#059669) for 'Eligible' badges and success states.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Solid Backgrounds with subtle borders instead of Glassmorphism. Glassmorphism can feel alienating or visually confusing for rural/elderly demographics.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (#E7E5E4) on cards, with soft diffuse shadow (shadow-sm) on hover.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Slightly rounded corners (rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for pill buttons).

components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Checkbox. All inputs must be large and legible (min 44px height for touch targets).
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for the Scheme Detail views to keep users in context without full page reloads.
components.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for switching between 'Schemes List', 'Document Locker', and 'Comparison'.
components.progress: Use Shadcn Progress for the Questionnaire completion status.
components.toast: Use Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Document saved to locker').

layouts.general: Generous Spacing Philosophy. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Wide gaps.
layouts.grid: Bento Grid protocol for desktop dashboards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing.
layouts.navigation: Solid background header with a hard bottom border. Never transparent over content. Must include Logo and Language Switcher prominently.
layouts.mobile: Mobile-first approach. Cards stack vertically. Bottom sticky navigation for key actions (Chatbot).
layouts.chatbot: Floating action button in the bottom right, expanding into a conversational interface card. Keep it accessible and prominent.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase on scheme cards.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-opacity, transition-colors), NEVER 'transition-all'.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for lists of schemes.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='apply-scheme-btn'`).
accessibility.multilingual: UI must accommodate varying text lengths for 22 vernacular languages. Avoid fixed heights on text containers.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for clean, universally understood interface icons.

hero_citizen.description: Smiling rural Indian citizen (for general welfare schemes)

healthcare_worker.description: Smiling Indian healthcare worker (for health schemes)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using standard React (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS.
Implement the Yojana Sahayak chatbot as a persistent, floating UI element that can stream AI responses.
The Document Readiness Locker should visually map to required documents for eligible schemes, showing a clear 'Ready' vs 'Missing' state.
Ensure the printable Eligibility Report has a clean, print-friendly layout (using print: Tailwind modifiers).
Never use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Focus on responsive design, ensuring tables and comparison tools are usable on small mobile screens (horizontal scroll if necessary).
Include standard Shadcn UI installations. Do not use generic native HTML tags for interactive elements.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (though for this app, prefer solid surfaces for accessibility).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`
